text: Eurobet is the largest Italian brand inside the Entain group. It was founded in 1995, acquired by Coral in 1998, became part of Ladbrokes Coral in 2016, passed to GVC in 2018, and to Entain when the group renamed in December 2020; combined with Entain's other Italian brands it holds an 11.9% share of the Italian market.

source.name: iGaming Times - Eurobet operator profile
source.quote: Eurobet is the largest Italian brand in the Entain group, headquartered in Rome and operating just under 1,000 sports betting shops through a franchising model.
